info.name: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD) Asset Planetary API
NASA Get Astronomy Picture of the Day

params.name: api_key
params.description: API key for authentication. Use DEMO_KEY for testing.

params.name: date
params.description: The date of the APOD image to retrieve (YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start of a date range for multiple APOD images.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end of a date range. Defaults to today.

params.name: count
params.description: Return a specified number of random APOD images.

params.name: thumbs
params.description: Return URL of video thumbnail if media type is video.

items.docs: Returns the astronomy picture of the day. Can retrieve a specific date, a date range, or random images.
